result.summary: Found 1 major issue: broken text layout in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant card where delivery time information appears corrupted or improperly formatted.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays corrupted text '25-380delivery' instead of proper delivery time format. The text appears to have line wrapping or overflow issues where delivery time and category information are misaligned and run together.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout to properly display delivery time (e.g., '25-30 min') and cuisine category on separate lines or with proper spacing, similar to other restaurant cards that show delivery time with correct formatting
